newsitem.title: UK: NWE JET SLIPS $3.00 WITH GAS OIL, BARGE DIFFS EASE.
newsitem.headline: NWE JET SLIPS $3.00 WITH GAS OIL, BARGE DIFFS EASE.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices slipped over $3.00 a tonne on Friday on the back of weaker IPE gas oil and barge differentials were a touch lower in a fairly notional market.
August IPE gas oil was trading $3.00 down at $169.50 around 1600 GMT.
Premiums for physical barges and cargoes of jet against the screen were steady to a touch weaker amid very slow spot demand.
Airline buying on contract was hitting liquidity.

Premium jet barges were pegged around $17 over IPE August gas oil, a diferential slip of $1 or so. Cargo premiums were holding at about $17.00 above September gas oil for early to mid August delivery.
Dealers said prices had eased a touch on the back of expectations of Middle East Gulf material heading into NWE in the second half of August.
"I have tried to get +$18.00 (for a barge) and have got nowhere, its too high," said one trader.
French, Greek and Italian sellers have become noticeably short of product, traders said with Mediterranean end-users looking balanced into next week.
